baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence marker, conditional time phrase, volitional verb, and causative ansharahu make a deliberately initiated second phase the most direct focus-only reading.
baseline_models.mechanism: A volitional act actualizes revival after death. The sequence is deferred but not vague: when the willing occurs, the same singular person becomes living again.

activation_trace.role: The branch literally supplies willing directed toward bringing about a thing; here it functions as the initiating switch for the second phase.
The branch literally denotes reviving the dead after death and supplies the core event applied to the singular object pronoun.

changed_reading.before: Then some future action happens to him.
changed_reading.after: Then, at a willed time, the same dead person is deliberately returned to life.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Ansharahu retains the root's opening, spreading, and branching image even while its causative form supports revival.
baseline_models.mechanism: Revival is a change of state from folded or hidden singularity into expanded manifestation. Biological restoration and spatial unfolding remain co-present rather than competing glosses.

activation_trace.role: The branch literally makes willing productive of a thing and functions as the cause that converts latency into manifestation.
The branch literally opens, spreads, and ramifies what was gathered; it gives revival an expansion-from-closure mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Revival restores a prior biological condition.
changed_reading.after: Revival opens the person out of latency into an expanded and manifest condition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same n-sh-r inventory explicitly includes dry pasture becoming green after rain.
baseline_models.mechanism: The person can be imagined as dormant living matter rather than inert absence: an enabling act makes concealed capacity return as growth.

activation_trace.role: The branch literally supplies effectual willing and functions as the enabling condition analogous to the arrival of reviving rain.
The branch literally images dry pasture greening after rain; it models personal revival as the reactivation of dormant life.

changed_reading.before: Ansharahu denotes only a personal return from death.
changed_reading.after: The personal return also carries the material logic of rain-revived growth emerging from dormancy.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The open-writing branch of n-sh-r can attach to the human object pronoun without replacing the direct resurrection sense.
baseline_models.mechanism: To bring the person forth is also to unseal or publish that person as something knowable. The person is not turned into a document; bodily return and public readability are provisionally coupled.

activation_trace.role: The branch literally identifies a thing as knowable and reportable; it supplies the tentative readability of the person brought forth.
The branch literally supplies writing or an unsealed open document and functions as a publication resonance within ansharahu.

changed_reading.before: He restores an otherwise private body to life.
changed_reading.after: He brings the person forth as both living and newly open to knowledge or report.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening scene contracts a face, turns attention away, and leaves a blind seeker socially unseen even as he arrives. Against that motion, ansharahu can be heard as the divine reversal: the hidden or disregarded human is made to arrive in full manifestation.

activation_trace.role: The branch literally opens and spreads what was closed; it supplies the reversal from contracted attention to manifest presence.
The branch literally contracts the face under pressure or anger; it establishes the initial closing motion that revival reverses.
The branch literally denotes turning away and functions as social occlusion of the person who has come.
The branch literally supplies coming into occurrence or presence; it makes arrival the counter-motion to being turned away from.
The branch literally supplies loss of sight and functions as the concrete condition around which human visibility and neglect are tested.

structural_cues: The opening motion runs from facial contraction through turning away to the blind seeker's arrival, while the focus verb later supplies opening and manifestation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contraction, aversion, blind arrival, and opening; I infer an ethical reversal from human non-recognition to divine manifestation. A live alternative is that the opening episode critiques present attention without modifying the resurrection verb.

changed_reading.before: God raises an anonymous dead person.
changed_reading.after: God reverses the human economy of aversion by making even the unseen and disregarded person fully present.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier whoever-wills construction links human willing to recollection; the focus links willing to bodily reanimation. The repeated volitional hinge makes resurrection sound like a higher-order retrieval into presence, while preserving the asymmetry between human response and divine effectuation.

activation_trace.role: The branch literally supplies willing that brings about its object; in the focus it effects bodily return rather than only a mental response.
The branch literally revives the dead and functions as the divine-scale counterpart to bringing a forgotten item back to mind.
The branch literally supplies volitional choice here as the repeated hinge that pairs present remembrance with future reanimation.
The branch literally restores something to awareness after absence; it supplies the retrieval pattern analogically enlarged in the focus.

structural_cues: The same volitional form occurs at 80:12 and 80:22, first with remembrance and then with reanimation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated willing, recollection after absence, and revival after death; I infer a scale-shift from mental retrieval to ontological retrieval. The repetition may instead mark only a contrast between two kinds of agency.

changed_reading.before: The willing clause merely leaves the date of resurrection unspecified.
changed_reading.after: The willing clause echoes voluntary remembrance and casts resurrection as divine retrieval of the person into presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Written sheets, elevation, and writing that reveals what is inscribed activate the open-document branch already latent in ansharahu. The person and a readable record become co-manifest: resurrection is not only reanimation but unsealing into public intelligibility.

activation_trace.role: The branch literally supplies an open written document; it lets ansharahu carry a publication mechanism while still taking the person as object.
The branch literally unfolds and spreads; it supplies the shared physical action by which both sheet and person become exposed.
The branch literally supplies a written sheet and gives the nearby reminder a concrete document medium.
The branch literally raises an object and links textual elevation to the focus's later bringing-forth motion.
The branch literally treats a book as revealing its writing; it supplies readability as the function of opening.

structural_cues: A sustained document-and-messenger sequence at 80:11-16 stands immediately before the human creation-to-resurrection sequence at 80:17-22.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sheets, revealing writing, elevation, and the focus root's open-document image; I infer that person and record are disclosed together. The live alternative is that the sheets concern only the reminder and never become the person's dossier.

changed_reading.before: Resurrection returns a private body to life.
changed_reading.after: Resurrection co-opens the living person and a readable account, making return also an act of publication.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human is measured into a bounded form, loses force and life, and is placed into concealment. The focus then reverses that chain through n-sh-r: the same measured singular is opened out of buried latency into renewed manifestation.

activation_trace.role: The branch literally opens and spreads what was gathered; it functions as the inverse of bounding and burial.
The branch literally restores the dead to life and keeps the spatial inversion tied to actual resurrection.
The branch literally measures or proportions a thing; it supplies the person's first bounded configuration.
The branch literally brings a thing to its determinate limit and reinforces the phase of bounded individuation.
The branch literally supplies loss of life and force, establishing the latency that revival must reverse.
The branch literally supplies hiddenness and depression; it turns burial into the closed state from which unfolding proceeds.

structural_cues: Repeated then-markers separate eased passage, death-and-burial, and ansharahu into successive state transitions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measure, limit, power-loss, concealment, and opening; I infer a compression-to-expansion arrow. A live alternative is that the opening branch adds no spatial mechanism beyond the direct revival branch.

changed_reading.before: He raises the person after burial.
changed_reading.after: He reverses measured, powerless concealment by unfolding that same bounded person into renewed manifestation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate denial of completed command interrupts any reading of resurrection as a self-contained happy endpoint. Bringing the person forth instead opens an unsettled relation between obligation and performance, making revival the onset of exposure rather than acquittal.

activation_trace.role: The branch literally revives the dead and supplies the event whose apparent finality the next statement disturbs.
The branch literally opens a written document and functions as the possibility that revival opens an account rather than closes one.
The branch literally supplies completion and termination; its negation prevents the sequence from reading as finished.
The branch literally supplies binding request or command and defines the outstanding relation exposed by return.

structural_cues: The abrupt kalla and not-yet construction follows the focus without a new narrative setup.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies revival followed by denied completion of a command; I infer that return exposes nonperformance. The live alternative is that 80:23 looks backward only to mortal life and is not temporally subsequent to resurrection.

changed_reading.before: Raising is the completed final act in the person's sequence.
changed_reading.after: Raising reopens the person into unfinished responsibility; it is disclosure and confrontation, not completion or acquittal.

context_deltas.mechanism: Poured water reaches fertile ground, the enclosure splits, and seed-life emerges. This later material sequence realizes the focus root's dry-pasture branch and makes resurrection legible as germination from concealed capacity rather than an unexplained jump.

activation_trace.role: The branch literally images dry pasture greening after rain and supplies the exact ecological template activated by the food sequence.
The branch literally supplies forceful pouring and functions as the initiating transfer into dormant ground.
The branch literally conveys water by irrigation or pouring and supplies the enabling medium of reanimation.
The branch literally splits something open and supplies the breached enclosure through which latent life emerges.
The branch literally supplies soft fertile earth and makes burial-ground and seed-ground materially comparable.
The branch literally supplies vegetation emerging from earth and functions as the visible completion of latent return.
The branch literally supplies a seed that sprouts and bears more seed; it gives the return a compact-to-ramified trajectory.

structural_cues: The command to inspect food introduces a causal chain of water, split earth, emergence, and branching produce after the focus's resurrection statement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rain transfer, fertile earth, rupture, sprouting seed, and the focus's rain-revived-pasture branch; I infer the food cycle as a material model for the buried body. It may instead function only as a proof from providence, not as texture inside ansharahu.

changed_reading.before: Resurrection is a discontinuous recall to life with no visible material process.
changed_reading.after: Resurrection is staged as germination: enabling water reaches concealment, earth opens, and compressed life emerges and branches.

context_deltas.mechanism: When the overwhelming event arrives, the human network does not reassemble as a protective collective: a person flees a binding relation and each individual is enclosed by an absorbing concern. The singular him in ansharahu thus opens into radical individuation rather than anonymous mass revival.

activation_trace.role: The branch literally spreads and disperses; it supplies movement into a public event-field while the singular pronoun preserves individual identity.
The branch literally supplies event-arrival and functions as the threshold at which the revived social field changes.
The branch literally supplies flight and turns post-arrival spreading into separation rather than reunion.
The branch literally images a fastening bond and supplies the relation from which the person now flees.
The branch literally supplies encompassing totality and makes each individual, not the kin group, the complete unit of concern.
The branch literally supplies a person's affair or grave concern and functions as the individually absorbing burden after dispersion.

structural_cues: The branchless root ص خ خ at 80:33 is used only as the structural marker of an overwhelming acoustic threshold.
The singular person at 80:34 and each individual at 80:37 echo the singular object pronoun in the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies event-arrival, flight from a bond, each-person syntax, absorbing concern, and the focus's spreading image; I infer individuation as a consequence of being brought forth. The social rupture may instead be a later judgment scene with no semantic force inside ansharahu.

changed_reading.before: Revival gathers humanity back as an undifferentiated mass.
changed_reading.after: Revival dispatches each preserved person into an exposed field where inherited bonds no longer carry individual responsibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final paired face-scenes make bodily surface carry disclosed state: some faces are uncovered and bright, while others acquire dust and an engulfing layer. The open-document and opening branches of n-sh-r converge here, making resurrection a publication of selfhood with more than one possible visible outcome.

activation_trace.role: The branch literally unfolds and exposes; it supplies the common mechanism by which the person becomes outwardly manifest.
The branch literally opens a readable document and functions as the analogy for a self made legible on its surface.
The branch literally removes a covering and functions as the bright outcome of disclosure.
The branch literally lets face stand for the self and makes facial state a disclosure of the whole person.
The branch literally supplies visible skin or surface and locates inward outcome on an outwardly readable plane.
The branch literally supplies dust and earth-coloring; it gives the second disclosed outcome a residual burial-like overlay.
The branch literally overtakes and overpowers a surface; it makes the dark layer an active engulfing result rather than neutral dirt.
The branch literally covers and functions as the conceptual counterforce to unveiling.
The branch literally breaches a cover by deviation and supplies the paradox that attempted concealment itself becomes publicly exposed.

structural_cues: Two parallel face groups at 80:38-42 preserve opposed outcomes without collapsing them into one generic manifestation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unveiling, face-as-self, visible skin, dust-covering, engulfment, concealment, and breach; I infer that resurrection publishes interior condition on bodily surface. The faces may instead describe consequences after revival without specifying what ansharahu itself does.

changed_reading.before: The dead person is physically restored and then independently judged.
changed_reading.after: The restored person is simultaneously made legible: selfhood appears on the face, opened into brightness or overtaken by the residue of concealment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the remedy branch is form-distant from ordinary resurrection and the constriction cue occurs in a later face-scene. It remains anchored in an exact n-sh-r branch at the focus and gains a visible release mechanism from the later narrowing image. Render only as a secondary therapeutic resonance, never as the lexical replacement for revival.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Ansharahu activates the nushrah remedy branch: a treatment releases an afflicted person from what has bound or clouded him.

activation_trace.role: The branch literally supplies a remedy that removes affliction and functions as a release-from-binding overtone within reanimation.
The branch literally supplies narrowing and reduction; it provides the constricted condition from which the remedy resonance imagines release.

changed_reading.before: He revives him from biological death.
changed_reading.after: He also releases him from an afflicting constriction, allowing revival to sound like cure as well as reanimation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the saw branch is a remote lexical image and cannot define the causative verb here. It remains anchored to the focus root and is materially activated by the packet's explicit splitting of earth after burial. Render as a harsh tactile analogy for extraction, clearly subordinate to resurrection and germination.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The saw-cutting branch of n-sh-r can resonate with the later split-earth sequence as an image of opening the enclosure around the buried person.

activation_trace.role: The branch literally supplies sawing wood and falling cuttings; it contributes the abrasive texture of cutting open an enclosure.
The branch literally splits a thing open and functions as the visible earth-opening cue that activates the remote saw image.

changed_reading.before: He raises him intact from an already open setting.
changed_reading.after: The enclosing ground is forcefully cut and split to release him, adding extraction to the gentler image of growth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because generosity is a peripheral n-sh-r branch, not the ordinary sense of ansharahu. It remains branch-anchored and is independently activated by the nearby honored sheets and noble agents. Render only as value-coloring: the act of raising may be generous and dignifying, but generosity is not its direct gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The open-generosity branch allows the willed bringing-forth to carry an overtone of bestowed dignity rather than sheer force alone.

activation_trace.role: The branch literally supplies open generosity and nobility; it colors the act of bringing forth as a bestowed good.
The branch literally supplies honor and praiseworthy generosity and functions as the nearby dignity cue that activates this coloring.

changed_reading.before: Raising displays power without an affective or social valence.
changed_reading.after: The willed opening may also be heard as a generous restoration of dignity and manifest standing.

strongest_changes: Measured, powerless burial is reversed as opening from closure, so resurrection becomes an expansion of the preserved person rather than only a renewed heartbeat.
Written sheets before the focus and readable faces after it activate publication: person, account, and visible outcome can be opened together.
Water, split earth, and sprouting seed turn the dry-pasture branch into a concrete germination model for bodily return.
The not-yet-completed command and later kin-flight make bringing-forth an exposure into unfinished, singular responsibility rather than uncomplicated restoration.
summary.what_was_special: One focus verb sustained coexisting biological, spatial, textual, ecological, social, and therapeutic mechanisms. The repeated willing construction created an agency-and-retrieval mirror, while opening and spreading linked sheets, the buried body, split earth, dispersed persons, and disclosed faces without forcing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The person-record coupling is abductive; the earlier sheets may remain only the medium of reminder.
The growth sequence and final faces may explain consequences or furnish analogies without adding semantic payload to ansharahu itself.
The immediate not-yet-completed command may look backward to mortal life rather than describe a stage after resurrection.
The therapeutic, saw-cutting, and generosity outliers are exact branch activations but remain too branch-distant to use as direct glosses.
